description: This file contains unit tests for the HostEnvSanitizer component, verifying its behavior in sanitizing environment variables, handling overrides, diagnostics, and key validation.

classes.name: HostEnvSanitizerTests
classes.description: Unit test suite for HostEnvSanitizer, containing various test functions to validate environment variable sanitization logic.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests that certain environment variables related to shell tracing are sanitized and removed from the environment.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Verifies that only specified environment variables are allowed when shellWrapper mode is enabled.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Ensures that regular overrides remain intact when not in shellWrapper mode.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Checks that the inspector properly identifies blocked and invalid override keys.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Validates that Windows-style environment variable names are accepted and preserved.
